entities.name: SLC39A8
observations: Encodes ZIP8; rs13107325 causes the missense A391T substitution.

entities.name: rs13107325
observations: SLC39A8 A391T/ZIP8 missense variant; Thr391 carrier frequency was 12.3% in Crohn disease cases versus 6.3% in controls in a 2019 cohort (OR 2.1, P=0.01).
In 2019, no overall gut microbiome composition or microbial richness association survived adjustment across tested groups; selective OTU findings had limited replication.
A 2024 pediatric Crohn cohort secondary analysis found Veillonella sequence variants decreased in ileal mucosa of carriers; related bile-acid evidence included mouse and 1000IBD analyses.

entities.name: Crohn disease
observations: In one human cohort, SLC39A8 Thr391 variant carriers were more frequent among Crohn disease cases than controls (OR 2.1, P=0.01).

entities.name: Variant microbiome heterogeneity
observations: Evidence supports selective, context-dependent gut microbiome associations for rs13107325, not a robust broad compositional effect in healthy subjects; a Crohn cohort reported reduced ileal Veillonella.
